Claude's text now carries an invisible signature.

Anthropic has shipped a feature that embeds undetectable watermarks into every piece of text Claude generates. API outputs. Claude Code outputs. Chat responses. All of it. And copying and pasting the text does not strip the watermark.

This is a quiet but structural shift in how AI-generated content is governed. For years, the question of whether something was written by AI depended on detection tools that were unreliable and easy to fool. Now, one of the leading model providers is baking provenance directly into the content itself.

For enterprises operating in regulated industries — finance, healthcare, legal — this is significant. Audit trails, IP management, and compliance documentation all become more defensible when the content carries its own proof of origin.

For every business leader thinking about AI governance, the question is no longer whether you need traceability. It is whether your current tools provide it.
